scope: Logged-out iOS hamburger, authentication entry and native modal presentation
changes: iOS hamburger, drawer navigation, guest login action and backdrop use completed taps instead of touch-down activation
iOS drawer commits interactive and global open state in the reveal turn
Repeated open requests refresh deferred bookkeeping instead of cancelling the only pending commit
Drawer input host explicitly retains its native view
iOS authentication entries defer modal presentation until the root host commits Quotes
Deferred presentations are revoked by Back, broker changes, unrelated navigation and newer authentication requests
Preserved concurrent dismissTo navigation changes that avoid duplicate tab stacks

validation.deviceTransport: Metro LAN inspector; Windows separately detected the USB-connected Apple iPhone
validation.physicalIphoneVerificationMethod: Invoked existing navigation callbacks on the live iPhone through Hermes CDP and reviewed native screenshots. Physical finger input was not automated; user confirmation remains pending.
validation.screenshotMethod: Existing Expo Go RNViewShot module, drawViewHierarchyInRect at native dimensions; no app dependency added. Earlier renderInContext trial captures can omit native layers and are not used as final visual evidence.
